# scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Regenerates the docs that come from the code: reference pages, README blocks, and the changelog.

Writes what docs/docs-spec.md section 7 says is generated, and nothing else: a reference page per entry point and Bicep file (docs/reference/), the README's entry-points and connections blocks between their markers, and with -PullRequestPath the "Changelog:" lines of merged pull requests under CHANGELOG.md's Unreleased heading. The handbook it once built (wiki/) is retired (decision 0024): avd-ops holds the page for each repo. Text outside the markers is never touched. Before writing, it runs the privacy check (D11) on everything it would write and refuses on a finding. -Check writes nothing and exits 1 when anything is out of date.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-RepoPath` | string | no | `(Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent)` | The repo to regenerate; this one by default. |
| `-RepoName` | string | no |  | Its name as sources/sources.json has it; the folder name by default. |
| `-BrainPath` | string | no | `(Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent)` | A checkout of avd-second-brain, for sources/sources.json. |
| `-PullRequestPath` | string | no |  | Merged pull requests as JSON (an array of objects with number and body) whose "Changelog:" lines go into CHANGELOG.md. |
| `-Check` | switch | no |  | Write nothing; list what is out of date and exit 1 if anything is. |

## Examples

```powershell
./scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1
```
```powershell
./scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 -Check
```
```powershell
./scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 -RepoPath ../avd-swarm -RepoName avd-swarm -PullRequestPath ./merged.json
```
